settings.enable-bluetooth-desc: Read battery information exposed by BlueZ.
settings.bluetooth-filter-desc: Only include Bluetooth devices whose name contains this text.
settings.refresh-interval-desc: How often to query HID and BlueZ (minimum 5000).
settings.notifications-enabled-desc: Show low and critical battery notifications once per discharge cycle.
settings.warning-threshold-desc: Percentage at which a low-battery notification is shown.
settings.critical-threshold-desc: Percentage at which a critical-battery notification is shown.
